items.b: N Ramchander Rao, the president of Telangana BJP, faced house arrest due to his opposition to the Bharat Summit. He claimed that the Congress government was collaborating with anti-Bharat forces. KTR criticized Rahul Gandhi for participating in the summit while ignoring crucial issues in Telangana. items.t: TN to buy power for summer demand, caps procurement at lowest monthly bids
items.b: Tamil Nadu government has initiated short-term power procurement tenders to address rising electricity demand from January to June. The Tamil Nadu Electricity Board aims to secure power at the lowest monthly rates quoted by bidders. The approved procurement prices will vary from Rs 9.50 to Rs 13 per unit based on the month. items.t: TRAI crackdown on spam: Over 1.24 lakh mobile connections barred or disconnected in Jul-Sep
items.b: A total of 1,10,325 telecom resources, including mobile numbers, were barred from outgoing services for 15 days for the first violation, while 13,777 were disconnected for one year for repeat violations, according to TRAI’s quarterly report for the second quarter of 2026-27.
